avis.texte: I've used this product for about three months so far and I do enjoy it. I have acne prone oily skin. I will say that it is a bit of a curve to introduce it into your routine. I would equate it to a chemical exfoliator in a way. I would recommend if you have skin on the more sensitive side to use it maybe once a week at first and be cautious of what other actives you use it with. I started using it when I had a Vit. C serum and since I wasnt sure how it would react, I would not use the two products on the same night. I also did notice redness the first few times, but this subsided as my skin got used to it and it became a regular fixture in my routine. I do think it helps prevent the hyper pigmentation that I tend to get after a pimple and that the little white heads around my nose and chin have diminished.

Ive had clear skin and healthy skin barrier before I started using this product, gave me the worst acne/painful breakouts. Wouldn't recommend to anyone who has sensitive skin or acne prone skin, has lots of pore clogging ingredients. Non comedogenic!

My skin wasn't the clearest before I started using this, but after using it for about a week consistently I noticed it really made my skin breakout. I had acne on my upper cheekbone near my eye and I never breakout there. I have normal to combination skin. I thought it would help exfioliate but it just broke me out so I'll be returning it.

I have oily/combo skin, prone to acne. Used this 3 times with a day off in-between and it freaked out my skin so I had to stop use. Caused a lot of tingling and temporary redness during use. Had to return.

I bought this a couple days ago as i kept seeinf it on social media. My skin has been 100% clear for the last 6 months. I put this on my face as directed and it hurt / burned SO bad!!! I woke up woth a rash around my mouth, 7 DEEP painful pimples and extremely textured and red skin. My face is not sensitive so I am very shocked this happened. DO NOT BUY!!!!!!

I have been eyeing this product and since I have sensitive skin I started with the beginner level. While massaging product into my skin, I felt a gentle slight tingle. When I woke up I could see a small difference in my skin. I can't wait to get through this bottle and work my way up the intensity levels!

Omg i used this overnight and my skin this morning looks like a literal filter this morning! All my skincare i applied after penetrated so deeply! I feel super hydrated and smooth. I started w the 50 because i wasnt sure what to expect. IM OBSSESSED! Im pretty sensitive but this was perfect. Slight tingle but nothing bad at all. If youve been debating just do it! Its straight magic!!

I found this brand in the store and after reading more about it, I decided to try it. I started out with the 50 because I do have sensitive skin and I loved it! I used it all! I felt like my skin absorbed my skincare products more!

Since I'm picky about what I use on my sensitive skin, I was hesitant at first, but this has worked wonders for me. There's a slight tingle when I first apply it, but it eventually goes away and I haven't woke up with any irritation either!
